subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

As I review the events of my past life, I realise how________ are the influences that shape our destinies.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 1 i.e. subtle.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words:
 
• **Subtle** means not very noticeable; not very strong or bright.
 
 
• **For Example : ***Advertisements persuade us to buy things in very **subtle **ways.*
 
 
 
• *​***Crude **means simple and basic, without much detail, skill, etc.
 
 
• **For Example: ***The method was **crude **but very effective.*
 
 
 
• *​***Plain **means easy to see, hear or understand; clear.
 
 
• **For Example: ***She made it **plain **that she didn’t want to see me again.*
 
 
 
• *​***Artless **means without skill or finesse.
 
 
• **For Example: ***Her simple **artless **charm won us over instantly.*
 
 
 
• The sentence implies that when the person reviewed the events of his past life, he realized that the influences that shape our destiny are unnoticeable.
 
• *​*Therefore the correct answer is **option 1.**

 

**​****Complete sentence:* ****As I review the events of my life, I realise how **subtle**__ are the influences that shape our destinies.*
